title: Route child_redemption_screen.dart and parent_pending_redemptions_screen.dart error states through AppLocalizations instead of raw e.toString()
rule: EH-5 / AX-2 (no raw exception reaches presentation; everything user-facing via AppLocalizations/ARB) -- matches the currently-non-functional custom_lint rule no_e_to_string_in_ui
why: Both screens render the raw exception's toString() as the entire error-state UI, completely bypassing localization -- in an EN/Hebrew app, a Hebrew-locale user sees untranslated (and potentially technical/internal) English text if the balance or pending-redemptions stream errors. This is not a missing capability: the very same feature already has a sanctioned pattern for this (point_config_screen.dart:222,267 use `AppLocalizations.of(context)!.errorGeneric(e.toString())`, and gamification_screen.dart uses `l10n.errorLoadingCalendar` for its own error states) -- these two sites simply don't use it, an inconsistency within one feature slice.
recommendation: Replace `Text(e.toString())` with `Text(AppLocalizations.of(context)!.errorGeneric(e.toString()))` (or a more specific localized string) in both files, matching the pattern already used elsewhere in the same feature.
acceptance_criteria: Neither file renders a bare e.toString() as UI text; both route through an AppLocalizations-resolved string
A widget test pumps each screen in an error AsyncValue state under Locale('he') and asserts the rendered text is not raw English exception text
